### Numbering the Levites
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/numbering-the-levites
Passage: 1 Chronicles 23:27
Points:
- David systematically numbered and organized the Levites to prepare for temple service under Solomon.
- Because God gave Israel rest in Jerusalem, the Levites no longer needed to transport the portable tabernacle.
- The replacement of the temporary tabernacle with the temple prefigured Jesus Christ as the true dwelling of God.
- In Christ, every believer now enjoys direct priestly access to God's presence through our great High Priest.

### Devotional: 1 Chronicles 23
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/1-chronicles-23-1-peter-4-micah-2-luke-11/
Passage: 1 Chronicles 23:25-26
Points:
- Transitioning from the wilderness to permanent settlement in the Promised Land required practical reorganization of worship.
- Because God gave rest to His people and chose Jerusalem, the Levites ceased packing and carrying the tabernacle.
- The revision of Levite duties shifted work toward temple administration, music ministry, and judicial teaching.
- David's restructuring serves as a biblical model of maintaining fidelity to divine revelation while adapting flexibly to new contexts.
